subject: Unapplied credit allocation & proposed ledger correction plan
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@nimbuscloud.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@nimbuscloud.com
Date: 2028-05-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Unapplied credits hitting wrong invoice buckets — AR aging mismatch

Hi Stephanie,

We ran into a reconciliation problem during our May month-end that looks like a set of unapplied credits from our April remittance were applied against legacy invoice numbers tied to the old entity (CloudLegacy Ltd.) instead of the active invoice numbers currently in your AR. The result is our AP cannot clear the payments and your AR is overstated for the active invoices.

Quick summary:
- Payment reference: NIM-0501-AP
- Credit memo: #4712 (attached) for 11,250 EUR
- Payment amount: 32,500 EUR (applied across multiple invoices, appears correct)
- Unapplied credit lines show against invoice 43721 / 43755 (legacy IDs) rather than invoices 54021 / 54055 (current IDs)

I've attached our AP export and the credit memo PDF for your review (Attachment: nimbus_ap_payment_summary_May01.xlsx, credit_memo_4712.pdf). Can your team advise the best path to move the credit to the correct invoice buckets so we can close our month?

Liam
Accounts Payable
NimbusCloud
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-02T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Unapplied credits hitting wrong invoice buckets — AR aging mismatch

Team — forwarding Nimbus AP. TL;DR: external credit memo applied to legacy invoice IDs, causing AR aging variance and stuck unapplied cash in our ledger.

Can we triage this quickly and propose a minimal-impact correction path? My suggested approach (high level):
1) Move the unapplied credit amount out of the legacy invoice bucket into a temporary liability (Customer Credit Liability / GL 2401) so AR balances for active invoices are accurate;
2) Reapply credit to correct active invoices (54021 / 54055) once mapping confirmed;
3) If revenue has already been recognized on the legacy invoice IDs, run the revenue correction entries (reversing revenue + contra-revenue) or route to RevOps for simulation;
4) Provide Nimbus a confirmation letter and updated AR statement for reconciliation.

Please pull the attached AP export from Liam and validate the exact invoice/credit lines. Grace — can you own the journal entry recommendation and simulation? Rishi — please confirm whether a revenue recognition reversal would be required if we reassign the credit after close. Lauren — once we have the journal drafts, please prep the GL postings and let me know if you need a sign-off cadence for finance leadership.

I am including the AP export Liam attached.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Rev Ops Partner, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Attachment: nimbus_ap_payment_summary_May01.xlsx (forwarded)
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-06T11:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Unapplied credits hitting wrong invoice buckets — AR aging mismatch

Thanks — dug into the export and ran a quick reconciliation. Attaching the filtered ledger extract with line-level IDs (Attachment: nimbus_ap_ledger_export_May2028.csv). Key findings:

- Total unapplied credit amount: 11,250 EUR (matches credit memo #4712 sent by Nimbus)
- Credits currently sit against legacy invoices 43721 (6,750 EUR) and 43755 (4,500 EUR)
- Active invoices that should have received the credits are 54021 (6,750 EUR) and 54055 (4,500 EUR)

Proposed accounting entries (low-risk, preserves revenue footprint):
A) Move unapplied credit into Customer Credit Liability (GL 2401) from AR suspense (GL 2109):
   Dr AR suspense (2109) 11,250 EUR
   Cr Customer Credit Liability (2401) 11,250 EUR
   Narrative: Reclass unapplied credit from legacy invoice mapping to liability while we verify apply-targets.

B) Apply credit from Customer Credit Liability to active invoices (54021 / 54055) once Nimbus confirms apply-to IDs:
   Dr Customer Credit Liability (2401) 11,250 EUR
   Cr Accounts Receivable (4000) 11,250 EUR
   Narrative: Reassign credit memos to proper invoice numbers; net AR balances corrected.

C) Revenue consideration: If revenue was recognized on the legacy invoice and the correction changes timing or counterparty recognition, we will either (1) post a reversing revenue entry and contra revenue or (2) if immaterial and within our tolerance, leave revenue intact and disclose in the periodic adjustments memo.

I've attached the CSV extract with columns: incoming_remit_ref, applied_invoice_id, applied_amount, corrected_invoice_id (proposed). Please review.

Next steps: Lauren to prepare GL journal drafts A & B for sign-off; Rishi to confirm rev rec impact and whether we need a J/E # for reversing revenue. I recommend we do the liability reclass (A) prior to month-close to clean AR aging, then apply (B) after Nimbus confirms.

Attachment: nimbus_ap_ledger_export_May2028.csv

—Grace
Grace O'Connor
Director, Accounts Receivable
redwood.com
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-10T14:49:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Unapplied credits hitting wrong invoice buckets — AR aging mismatch

Agree with the liability reclass approach for AR aging purposes. A couple of notes from a revenue-recognition perspective: 

- Please confirm whether the legacy invoices (43721 / 43755) have had revenue recognized in prior periods. If so, we need to run a simulation to estimate the impact of reassigning the credit to active invoices. That simulation should include: deferred revenue balances, month-of-recognition, and tax/VAT carry-forwards.
- If revenue has already been recognized and we apply the credit to a different invoice, the standard treatment is a reversing revenue entry + contra revenue (or a credit memo offset depending on the revenue system). This will require a RevOps dry-run in staging to ensure downstream revenue reports and bookings are not disrupted.
- Please provide a short list of all invoices impacted (both legacy IDs and target IDs). I will run a rev-rec simulation and post results (expected impact: likely immaterial < 5k EUR to recognized revenue, but we need to confirm).

Lauren: once Grace provides the journal drafts and the impacted invoice list, I will schedule a 30-minute dry-run with RevOps (sandbox) and loop in Tax if there are VAT timing implications.

Rishi
Head of Revenue Operations
redwood.com
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@nimbuscloud.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@nimbuscloud.com, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-15T17:05:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Unapplied credits hitting wrong invoice buckets — AR aging mismatch

Hi Liam — thanks for the quick flag and for sending the credit memo. We have a proposed, low-risk plan and would like your confirmation on two small items so we can execute by EOD Friday (2028-05-18):

What we'll do (planned sequence):
1) Move the 11,250 EUR from AR suspense into Customer Credit Liability (GL 2401) to correct AR aging before month-close. This is an internal reclass — it does not change the cash position.
2) Once Nimbus confirms the correct target invoice IDs (please confirm 54021 and 54055), we will apply the credit from the liability to those invoices and send you an updated AR statement showing the applied items.
3) Rishi is running a rev-rec simulation in staging. If the simulation shows any material recognized revenue reversal is needed, we'll present the journal options. If immaterial, we'll proceed with the re-apply and capture the adjustment in the periodic revenue memo.

Action items for Nimbus: 
- Please confirm that the intended apply-to invoice IDs are 54021 (6,750 EUR) and 54055 (4,500 EUR) OR provide the correct invoice numbers.
- Confirm acceptance of our proposed sequencing (liability reclass now, re-apply once you confirm the invoice IDs).

I've attached the credit memo you originally sent for reference and will share our GL journal draft once Lauren prepares it. Expected timeline: reclass entry in our GL tomorrow (2028-05-16) and re-application within 1–2 business days after your confirmation.

Attachments: credit_memo_4712.pdf (attached to this thread)

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Rev Ops Partner
Redwood Inference
